{"success": true, "data": {"stdout": "#!/bin/bash
set -e
source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
conda activate base
cd /root/autodl-tmp/struct_self_consist_ie

export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=2,3
export FORCE_TORCHRUN=1
export NNODES=1
export NPROC_PER_NODE=2
export PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True

mkdir -p logs output/fewnerd_7b

echo "=== $(date) === Phase 1: QLoRA Training ==="
llamafactory-cli train train_config_qwen25_7b_fewnerd_s42.yaml 2>&1 | tee logs/train_qwen25_7b_fewnerd_s42.log
TRAIN_EXIT=$?
echo "TRAINING_EXIT_CODE=$TRAIN_EXIT" >> logs/train_qwen25_7b_fewnerd_s42.log
if [ $TRAIN_EXIT -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "ERROR: Training failed with exit code $TRAIN_EXIT"
    exit 1
fi

echo "=== $(date) === Phase 2: Export/Merge LoRA ==="
unset FORCE_TORCHRUN
unset NPROC_PER_NODE
export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=2
llamafactory-cli export export_config_qwen25_7b_fewnerd.yaml 2>&1 | tee logs/export_qwen25_7b_fewnerd.log

echo "=== $(date) === Phase 3: Inference (3 seeds x N=8) ==="
for SEED in 42 123 456; do
    echo "--- $(date) --- Seed $SEED ---"
    python code/run_mvp_pilot.py \
        --model_path checkpoints/qwen25-7b-fewnerd-merged \
        --data_dir data/fewnerd \
        --dataset fewnerd \
        --subtask ner \
        --n_samples 8 \
        --temperature 1.0 \
        --seed $SEED \
        --collect_logprobs \
        --output_dir output/fewnerd_7b/qwen25_7b_n8_seed${SEED}
    echo "--- $(date) --- Seed $SEED inference done ---"
done

echo "=== $(date) === Phase 4: Signal Analysis ==="
for SEED in 42 123 456; do
    echo "--- Analyzing seed $SEED ---"
    python code/analyze_fewnerd_results.py \
        --input_dir output/fewnerd_7b/qwen25_7b_n8_seed${SEED} \
        --output_dir output/fewnerd_7b/qwen25_7b_n8_seed${SEED}
done

echo "=== $(date) === Phase 5: Entity Construction ==="
for SEED in 42 123 456; do
    echo "--- Entity construction seed $SEED ---"
    python code/wnut17_entity_construction.py \
        --input_dir output/fewnerd_7b/qwen25_7b_n8_seed${SEED} \
        --output_dir output/fewnerd_7b/qwen25_7b_n8_seed${SEED} \
        --n_samples 8
done

echo "=== $(date) === ALL PHASES COMPLETE ==="
echo "PIPELINE_EXIT_CODE=0"
